sloka: त्वं तु लङ्केश्वरस्तात भविष्यसि न संशयः ।त्वया राक्षसवंशो ऽयं निमग्नो ऽपि समुद्धृतः ।सर्वेषां नः प्रभुश्चैव भविष्यसि महाबल ।। ७.११.९ ॥
transliteration: tvaṁ tu laṅkeśvarastāta bhaviṣyasi na saṁśayaḥ ।tvayā rākṣasavaṁśo 'yaṁ nimagno 'pi samuddhṛtaḥ ।sarveṣāṁ naḥ prabhuścaiva bhaviṣyasi mahābala ।। 7.11.9 ॥

translations.english: O dear and mighty one, you will undoubtedly be the lord of Lanka, for by you this Rakshasa race, even though submerged, has been uplifted, and you will indeed be the master of all of us.
